Formulation
A 27-year-old male with a history of eczema and penicillin allergy reports occasional anxiety/panic attacks (no formal diagnosis or prior treatment). Current presentation is situational anxiety following a wasp/bee sting, with fear of serious allergic reaction. No features of an acute life-threatening reaction were observed by the clinician during video assessment. Predisposing factors: personal history of anxiety/panic symptoms (patient-reported). Precipitating factors: recent insect sting. Perpetuating factors: worry about potential anaphylaxis; lives alone (support unknown). Protective factors: help-seeking behavior; employed. No mental health risk to self/others assessed in this consult.
